messages:
marta_finance: Heads up — noticed a batch of invoices in tonight's run with duplicated platform fees. Net revenue on ~120 invoices is off by the exact application_fee_amount repeated twice. Reporting job flagged it (billing_summary).

ashley_recon: Ugh. Are those webhooks replay-related or downstream mapping?

marta_finance: Looks webhook-y. Searching stripe events shows multiple delivered events for the same charge id with 200 responses, but our webhook handler still created a fee ledger line each time. Example payload snippet:

```json
{"id":"evt_1Lxxxx","type":"charge.succeeded","data":{"object":{"id":"ch_1Abc","amount":10000,"application_fee_amount":500}}}
```

sam_engineering: That suggests we're not checking event idempotency. Our handler only checks charge id, not event id, and retries that get reprocessed cause a second fee insertion. I can reproduce locally by POSTing same event twice.

paul_devex: Do we have an idempotency key column for stripe_event_id in billing_events table? I thought we added that for refunds..

sam_engineering: We have stripe_charge_id dedupe but not stripe_event_id. So if Stripe re-sends the same event for any reason (retries, or our intermediate ack loss), the charge dedupe passes and we still write application fee line.

ashley_recon: NetSuite side consequence: fee lines are mapped to expense account EX-PLT-100 instead of revenue contra, so when duplicated it reduces net revenue incorrectly in GL. For now finance reports show a bunch of -$500 lines.

marta_finance: Is this a recent regression? Any deploys touching webhooks?

sam_engineering: We rolled webhook consumer change three days ago (idempotent processing for refunds only). That change inadvertently removed a guard in the charge handler. I'm owning the fix. Quick mitigation options: 1) run a backfill to dedupe duplicate fee ledger lines for events where stripe_event_id repeats; 2) block further webhook reprocessing by returning 200 only after marking event idempotent.

paul_devex: For mitigation 1, a safe SQL to find duplicates:

```sql
SELECT charge_id, application_fee_amount, COUNT(*) cnt, array_agg(id) ids
FROM billing_fee_lines
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY charge_id, application_fee_amount
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

ashley_recon: We should also pause nightly billing_summary job until we patch, otherwise downstream reporting will keep sending incorrect numbers to CX. Can ops-bot pause it? @ops-bot please.

ops-bot: Received command: pause job billing_summary. Job paused by ops-bot at 2026-03-23T04:12:09Z.

sam_engineering: I'll open a PR to add stripe_event_id uniqueness and early-return if event already processed. PR will include a migration to add unique index and a script to mark the processed_event for recent events.

marta_finance: Also need a plan for the NetSuite sync — duplicated fee lines already pushed for ~40 invoices this morning. We need to reverse the duplicate fee line in NetSuite for those invoices.

ashley_recon: I'll generate a list of affected invoices once we dedupe local ledger lines. Then we can create a NetSuite reversal batch (journal entries) and set a flag so the sync doesn't re-apply.

paul_devex: Priority: hotfix to webhook handler (patch + deploy), run dedupe migration & script, produce CSV for NetSuite reversals, resume billing_summary after validation. ETA on hotfix?

sam_engineering: Hotfix PR in 30m, request for quick-review tag. If approved, can ship under maintenance window in 1h. Will add instrumentation to count duplicate event hits.

marta_finance: Thanks. Once patched, let's run a reconciliation: compare stripe payout amounts vs our net revenue for last 7 days, and post a short memo for accounting.

ashley_recon: I'm on it — will post reconciliation CSV to #finance-archives when ready.

paul_devex: Also add a unit test and an integration test that replays identical event payloads to ensure no duplicate fee creation.

sam_engineering: Will do. Assigning to me: FIN-786 webhook idempotency + FIN-787 dedupe script.

marta_finance: Great. @everyone please react to confirm and I'll follow up with exec summary later. :thumbsup:

ashley_recon: :thumbsup:

paul_devex: :thumbsup:
